summary: Armstrong World Industries filed an 8-K reporting results of its June 11, 2026 Annual Meeting. Shareholders elected nine director nominees, ratified KPMG as auditor, approved the 2026 Directors Stock Unit Plan, and gave advisory approval of executive compensation. The filing also lists post-meeting committee appointments. There are no extraordinary corporate events—no acquisitions, divestitures, or structural changes—just standard governance items. This is a routine current report of shareholder votes and board committee assignments.
